chemistry-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-07.material: Xaaladda caadiga ah (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; gaas 1 mol = 22.4 L), mugga isku-darka gaaska ka kooban methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) iyo carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) waa 11.2 L, cufkuna waa 16.4 g. Culeysyada atomiga waa H=1, C=12, O=16, lambarka Avogadro-na waa $N_A$. Waa imisa wadarta tirada atomyada ku jira isku-darkan gaaska ah?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Xaaladda caadiga ah (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; gaas 1 mol = 22.4 L), mugga isku-darka gaaska ka kooban methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) iyo carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) waa 11.2 L, cufkuna waa 16.4 g. Culeysyada atomiga waa H=1, C=12, O=16, lambarka Avogadro-na waa $N_A$. Waa imisa wadarta tirada atomyada ku jira isku-darkan gaaska ah?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Wadarta mole = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Tallaabo 2: Cufka: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Ku beddel y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Tallaabo 3: Tirada atomyada: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ waxay leedahay 5 atom molecule kasta → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ waxay leedahay 3 atom molecule kasta → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Wadar 1.9 mol atom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Jawaab: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Jawaabaha khaldan: 1.5 waxaa loo qaatay dhammaan CO2, 2.5 waxaa loo qaatay dhammaan CH4, 1.7 waxay tirisay atomyada CH4 kaliya 4 H.)
